metadata.title: Dashboard Initial Load and Basic Status Update

story.iWant: to see my study activities on a dashboard and update their status
story.soThat: I can easily track my progress and keep my study plan up-to-date.
story.tasks: - Implement dashboard component to display study activities. - Fetch initial study session data from Supabase. - Render study activities in a calendar view. - Implement `StudyTaskCard` component for displaying individual study activities. - Design interactive element to update status. - Integrate status update logic with `DashboardManager.updateSessionStatus`. - Implement `DashboardManager` service to handle data fetching and status updates. - `getDashboardData()` to fetch initial courses and sessions. - `updateSessionStatus(sessionId, newStatus)` to send updates to Supabase. - Integrate Supabase Realtime for `study_sessions` table changes. - Ensure all data interactions are subject to RLS policies. - Implement optimistic updates for task status changes in the UI.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. The dashboard displays a calendar view of the user's study activities (AC1 from Tech Spec). 2. A user can update the status of a study activity ('Not Started', 'Completed', 'Missed') (AC4 from Tech Spec). 3. Progress updates are saved automatically and are persistent across sessions (AC5 from Tech Spec). 4. Changes made to the study plan are reflected on the dashboard in near real-time without requiring a page refresh (AC6 from Tech Spec).

artifact.title: Epic Technical Specification: Dashboard & Progress Tracking
artifact.snippet: This document provides the technical specification for Epic 4: Dashboard & Progress Tracking. This epic covers the primary user interface for daily interaction with the study planner. It's where users will visualize their generated schedule, track their progress, and update the status of their study tasks.

artifact.title: Epic Technical Specification: Dashboard & Progress Tracking
artifact.snippet: In-Scope: A main dashboard view featuring a calendar of study activities. Progress bars for each course, giving a visual overview of completion. The ability to click on a daily activity to view its details. Functionality to update the status of a study activity (e.g., 'Not Started', 'Completed', 'Missed'). Automatic and persistent saving of progress updates.

artifact.title: Epic Technical Specification: Dashboard & Progress Tracking
artifact.snippet: This epic realizes the "daily-use loop" described in the architecture and relies heavily on the frontend and its direct integration with Supabase. The Next.js Frontend will fetch all study_sessions for the user directly from the Supabase Database and render them in the UI.

artifact.title: AI-Powered Personal Study Planner UX Design Specification
artifact.snippet: Vision: Transform academic stress into focused productivity. Core Experience: Effortless daily check-in, dynamic rescheduling. Desired Emotional Goal: Empowered, in control, calm, confident.

artifact.snippet: Core User Action: Daily check-in (view dashboard, update task status). Interaction must be fast, simple, satisfying. Most Effortless Interaction: "Welcome Back" wizard for adaptive planning.

artifact.snippet: Custom component to display a study task. Purpose: Fast, satisfying status updates. Anatomy: Course Title, Task Title, Status Indicator, Action Area (entire card). States: Not Started, In Progress, Completed, Missed. Behavior: Click to cycle status, hover for 'Missed' action.

artifact.title: AI-Powered Personal Study Planner UX Design Specification
artifact.snippet: Success: Non-intrusive toast notifications. Error: Persistent red toast (critical), inline messages (form validation). Loading: Skeleton loader (page), button spinner (action-specific).

constraint.description: Initial dashboard load, including all sessions for the upcoming month, should take less than 2 seconds.
UI updates after changing a task's status should feel instantaneous (< 200ms), leveraging optimistic updates and real-time events.
All data fetching is subject to the RLS policies on the `courses` and `study_sessions` tables, ensuring users only ever see their own data.
The frontend should be able to handle temporary disconnects from the Supabase Realtime service and automatically re-subscribe when the connection is restored.
Log any errors during real-time subscription or status updates to a frontend monitoring service.
Next.js Frontend direct integration with Supabase for data fetching and updates.
Adhere to Shadcn UI components for a consistent and modern aesthetic.

interface.name: IDashboardManager

tests.standards: Unit Tests: Test logic for calculating course progress and Zustand store state update logic. Component Tests: Extensively test the `StudyTaskCard` component in all its visual states and the calendar component to ensure it renders events correctly. Integration/E2E Tests: Test the full flow (load dashboard, change status, UI update). Use Supabase's testing tools to test real-time integration (update DB, assert client receives notification). Security Testing: Ensure all data interactions are subject to RLS policies.
tests.locations: Typically `__tests__` or `tests` directories within relevant feature modules.

ideas.idea: Verify calendar view displays study activities correctly for different date ranges.
Test `StudyTaskCard` status cycling (Not Started -> In Progress -> Completed) and Missed state.
Confirm status updates persist in Supabase after app restart/reload.
Integrate a test that modifies `study_sessions` in the DB directly and asserts UI reflects changes in real-time.
Verify RLS prevents unauthorized users from accessing/modifying `study_sessions` data.
